## Definition

Data governance is the allocation of authority and accountability for decisions about data.

## Evidence

Split authority appears to depress maturity
[[wiki/sources/fx_smith_governance_2021#C1|Smith 2021, C1]]: > "agencies reporting split CIO/program authority scored a full level lower on average" (p. 1).
